settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Your account, your company, and how chat behaves.

account.title: Account and appearance
account.hint: The account you are signed in with, and the interface theme.
account.name: Name

company.title: Company
company.hint: The company whose data you see.
company.only: you have no access to another company

members.title: Members and roles
members.hint: Who can reach what. Roles are managed by the company owner.
members.hintOwner: Can do everything; manages the team.
members.hintAdmin: Runs SQL, uploads data, edits dashboards.
members.addNote: If the person has no account yet, one is created and a single-use password is shown.
members.tempPasswordNote: This password is shown once. Pass it on yourself and ask them to change it after signing in.

sources.title: Data sources
sources.hint: The database your queries run against.
sources.none: No data source is defined for this company.
sources.managedElsewhere: Connection settings live on the admin side and cannot be changed here.

chat.title: Chat preferences
chat.maxRowsHint: The most rows a single answer may return.
chat.adminsOnly: Only admins can change these settings.
chat.modelSolHint: Fast and economical — for everyday questions.
chat.modelLunaHint: Stronger; more accurate on complex queries.

schema.title: Schema
schema.subtitle: Your tables and the relationships between them. Relationships are declared in the data model.
schema.emptyHint: Upload data, or ask your administrator to define a data source.
schema.noEdges: No relationships declared yet — the tables stand apart.
schema.noEdgesTail: point a column at another table's column.

model.title: Data model
model.subtitle: Give columns readable names, mark the ones that are categories, and hide the ones nobody needs. These settings also feed the breakout options and the chat's schema.
model.categoryHint: Category: appears in the breakout options

errors.title: Something went wrong.
errors.body: An unexpected error occurred. You can try again or go back to your dashboards.
errors.notFoundBody: The address may have changed, the content may be in the trash, or it may belong to another company.

palette.title: Command palette
palette.description: Search analyses, dashboards, chats and pages.
palette.placeholder: Search or jump to a page…

chat.heroBodyCompany: Ask a question about {company}'s data in plain language; the answer comes with a chart and the query behind it.
chat.heroBodyGeneric: Ask a question about your company's data in plain language; the answer comes with a chart and the query behind it.
chat.notConfigured: The chat service is not configured yet. Ask your administrator to set a key.
chat.placeholder: Ask a question about your data…
chat.enterHint: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line
chat.tablesPick: Pick a table to add to your question

boyahane: Who were the five highest-revenue customers last year?
Which machine has the most downtime, and why?
What is the average OEE per machine?
tenant2: How does the monthly invoice total change?
What is the total amount by invoice type?
Which movement type appears most in stock movements?
How do debit and credit split by account type?
generic: List the five most important indicators.

overview.title: Overview
overview.hintDashboards: Collect your saved analyses side by side on a dashboard.
overview.hintAnalyses: Ask a question in chat and save an answer you like as an analysis.
overview.hintUploads: Upload a CSV or Excel file to query your own tables.
overview.loadFailed: The data could not be loaded.

trash.title: Trash
trash.subtitle: Deleted analyses and dashboards wait here; restoring one keeps its links and its place on dashboards.
trash.emptyHint: Dashboards and analyses you delete wait here before they are removed for good.

browse.subtitle: Browse your company's tables: see the first 100 rows, and click a column header to sort.
browse.noInsights: No insights could be produced for this table.
browse.title: Data

gateway.nameTooShort: The name must be at least 2 characters.
gateway.engineSilent: The analytics service is not responding right now.
gateway.engineUnreachable: The analytics service could not be reached.
gateway.selfReference: A column cannot point at itself.
gateway.notAnUpload: This analysis is not backed by an uploaded table.
gateway.periodTooDeep: This period cannot be broken down any further.
gateway.noDetailView: This chart has no detail view.
gateway.ownerOnly: Only the company owner can do this.
gateway.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
gateway.alreadyMember: This person is already on the team.
gateway.noBreakoutDetail: This breakout has no detail view.
gateway.noCompanyAccess: You do not have access to this company.
gateway.noDataAccess: You do not have access to this data.
gateway.rateLimited: Too many requests; try again shortly.
gateway.fileTooLarge: The file is over the 20 MB limit.
gateway.noSheet: No sheet was found in the file.
gateway.ownRole: You cannot change your own role.
gateway.removeSelf: You cannot remove yourself from the team.
gateway.userNotCreated: The user could not be created.
gateway.ownerNotAddable: A company owner cannot be added from this screen.
gateway.chatPrefsAdminsOnly: Only admins can change the chat settings.
gateway.chatNotConfigured: The chat service is not configured yet.
gateway.chatSilent: The chat service is not responding right now.
gateway.chatNoAnswer: The chat service did not answer; try again.
gateway.chatMisconfigured: The chat service configuration is invalid.
gateway.chatOutOfCredit: The chat service is out of credit; let your administrator know.
gateway.queryFailed: The query could not be run.
gateway.unanswerable: The question could not be answered; try asking it more simply.
gateway.columnNameEmpty: A column name cannot be empty.
gateway.badFileType: Only .csv, .xlsx or .xls files can be uploaded.
gateway.engineEmpty: The analytics service returned an empty response.
gateway.engineNoAnswer: The analytics service could not produce an answer.
gateway.chatContextVersionUnsupported: This chat context version is not supported.

sql.subtitle: Run read-only queries against your company's data and save the result as an analysis.
sql.variablesHint: A variable left empty drops its [[ … ]] condition from the query. Current values become the defaults when you save.

upload.title: Upload data
upload.subtitle: Upload an Excel or CSV file; its first sheet is added to your company's data as a table you can query.
upload.dropzone: Drag a file here, or choose one
upload.amendHint: “Append” adds rows to the existing table; “Replace” swaps the table's rows for new ones. The columns must match.

card.drillHint: Click a bar or a point to explore it: categories open a breakout and their rows, periods open a daily or monthly view.

noAccess.title: You do not have access to this page
noAccess.body: Running SQL and uploading data are open to company admins only.

history.title: History
history.scope: Changes are recorded under the company account; they are not attributed to a person.

filters.badRange: The end date cannot be before the start date.
filters.valuesFailed: The values could not be loaded.

dashboards.newHint: A dashboard starts with a date filter; the charts you add are wired to it.
dashboards.name: Dashboard name
dashboards.addedUnwired: Added to the dashboard. Its filters do not apply to this chart.
dashboards.notFiltered: The filters do not apply to this chart.
dashboards.emptyHint: Add an analysis or a chat answer with “Add to a dashboard”.
dashboards.drillHint: Click a bar or a point to explore it. Filters are saved to the link.
dashboards.deleteBody: “{name}” moves to the trash; the analyses on it are not deleted.

login.subtitle: Sign in to reach your dashboards.
login.wrong: That e-mail or password is not right.
login.failed: Could not sign in; try again.
